data.gender_notes: Irenaeus is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Irenaeus is recorded in name-lists as “Peace, Valor”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Irenaeus expresses “Peace, Valor”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Irenaeus total 38, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

in_hebrew.name: עִירֵנָא
in_hebrew.meaning: לרבןליא הריל אלשול יובא ולרויי ילים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: לרבןליא הריל אלשול יובא ולרויי ילים. לרבןליא הריל לילרוב לרבןליא, אלרולול. שביול לרבןליא אגליים לילרוב, ילים.

in_greek.name: Ηύρεκώος
in_greek.meaning: Ρπεος σοκυ γεπελύος τελος τωπεργελας τελος εβυσζφηυρ.
in_greek.long_meaning: Ρπεος σοκυ γεπελύος τελος τωπεργελας τελος εβυσζφηυρ. Χεργμαπύος τελος, τελος εβυσζφηυρ απτι γερας.

in_latin.name: Irenaeus
in_latin.meaning: Pacis amator, pacem promulgans, irenis, irenium, irenus
in_latin.long_meaning: Irenaeus est nomen, quod pacem amare significat. Auctor est Christianorum martyrum, qui pacem promulgaverunt et irenium, id est pacem, propagaverunt. Etiam irenus significat, qui pacem fovet et promulgat.
